description: Block until something happens in a mailbox you can read, or until the window closes (at most 25 seconds). An empty answer means nothing happened: it is not a failure. Call again with the cursor it returned; a wait without that cursor starts from now and skips whatever happened in between.

agent_part.description: true: only mail carrying a machine-readable part; false: only mail without one. Absent: both.

cursor.description: Where to resume: the cursor the previous bud_wait returned, unchanged. Empty starts from now.

mailbox.description: Wait on this ag_ mailbox only. Empty waits on every mailbox you can read.

timeout_s.description: How long to wait, in seconds; 25 by default.

types.description: Only these event types. Empty means all of them.

name: bud_wait
